## 🐛 Fixed

- **The (i) icons open on a click.** A click or a tap on an (i), on TowerTorch's own settings and on every Settings and Tools page, opens its help and keeps it open until you click somewhere else. Before, the click closed the bubble the hover had just opened. Thanks @Revan335 ([#138](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/towertorch/issues/138)).
